vignette: A 41-year-old woman had pleuritic chest pain and migratory pleural effusions before pulmonary angiography identified an embolus.
A 5-year-old boy had progressive dyspnea and a CSF2RA variant associated with abnormal alveolar surfactant accumulation.
A 13-year-old boy had a large cervical swelling and biopsy findings of emperipolesis with S100-positive histiocytes.
A 50-day-old boy had persistent diarrhea, vomiting, bloating, and failure to thrive that improved with specialized fatty acids.
An adult man had recurrent neuropsychiatric symptoms after streptococcal infections and was treated with plasma exchange and rituximab.
A 58-year-old man had persistent fever, hip pain, salmon-colored rash, extreme ferritin elevation, and systemic inflammation.
A woman developed fever, chest and abdominal symptoms, rash, hypotension, and cardiac involvement weeks after COVID-19.
A woman with progressive brainstem symptoms had positive CSF JC-virus PCR after an initial multiple-sclerosis diagnosis.
A young woman with PCOS had persistent thoracic back pain followed by dynamic ECG and troponin changes and critical LAD disease.
A man with epigastric pain later developed leg weakness, sensory loss, and urinary retention; MRI showed an anterior spinal artery lesion.
